name: LMSubs
description: OpenAI-compatible ASR (speech-to-text) + LLM subtitle translation. Adds native 'LM Subtitles' / 'LM Subtitles (Live)' tracks: selecting one starts transcription at the current playback position, using cache when possible. Provider presets plus configurable Base URL / API Key / Model. No web modification.
overview: ASR transcription + LLM subtitle translation (native tracks, no web modification)

versions.changelog: Two-column settings page; provider dropdowns with default base URLs for ASR and translation; entire project in English.
